THE BUREAU’S SURVIVAL GUIDE

Don’t get
reeled in.

  1. Break the rush.

    Threats and tight deadlines can push you to act without checking. Pause before replying or paying.

  2. Take your own route.

    Open the company’s known app or website yourself. Ask support to confirm the request.

  3. Keep secrets secret.

    Never send passwords, PINs, or one-time codes in a message reply.

Already clicked or shared something? ↗

Stop interacting. Change exposed passwords through the real service and enable multi-factor authentication. If money or payment details are involved, contact your bank promptly using its official number. Report the message through official support.

Guidance: FTC phishing guide ↗. Warnings are clues, not proof.

PRESSURE TEST YOUR INSTINCTS

20 seconds.
One good instinct.

Eight fresh cases. Twenty seconds each. A correct call earns 100 points, plus up to 40 for speed. A wrong answer or timeout earns zero. The clock stops after your verdict so you can read the lesson.

Tip: speed is for the game. In real life, take your time to verify.

PRIVACY · UPDATED 14 NOV 2026

Your messages.
Your business.

Who runs this

The Phish Bureau is an independent prototype by Eian. Questions or deletion requests: limsieian@gmail.com.

Message checking and solo play

Local pattern checks stay on your device. If you select AI review, the displayed message text is sent through our server to Google’s Gemini API running Gemma 4. Our app does not store message text or model responses. This prototype uses the Gemini API free tier. Google may use free-tier submissions to improve its products under its API terms and retention policies. Remove sensitive details before sending. Never submit passwords, codes or payment details. Solo answers and case history remain in memory and disappear on reload.

Email imports are read locally and only the displayed text is used. The app does not connect to or read your inbox. AI request limits use aggregate counters without storing message contents or email addresses.

Optional live rooms

Joining a room sends your chosen nickname, room membership, answers, scores, and timing to our room server hosted through ChatGPT Sites. Participants can see nicknames and the leaderboard. Random player credentials are kept in your tab’s session storage to reconnect; they are removed when you leave the room.

Rooms become inaccessible after two hours. Expired room records are removed when a later room is created. Provider logs and backups may have their own retention periods. Use a nickname rather than a real name. Do not share a room code publicly if you want a private group.

Hosting and external services

GitHub Pages serves the site, ChatGPT Sites hosts live rooms, and Google Fonts supplies typefaces. These providers may process connection information such as IP addresses and browser details under their policies. We do not add advertising trackers or analytics cookies.

Contacting Eian

Contact links open your email app. Your email is sent to limsieian@gmail.com through your email provider and Gmail, not through the game server. It is used to respond to your enquiry. No automatic AI reply or continuous inbox monitoring is enabled by this website. You may request deletion by email.

THE BUREAU ANSWERS

A few things
worth knowing.

Is this an AI scam detector?

The message lab offers Gemma 4 AI review and a separate local pattern check. AI reviews language and context but can make mistakes. Neither option verifies identity, checks live link reputation, or proves safety.

Can it read my inbox directly?

No. You can paste a message or import a plain-text .eml or .txt file. Import is local until you choose AI review. Direct Gmail access would need a separate OAuth connection and your explicit permission.

How many cases can I play?

There are 80 authored fictional messages across 16 situations. Each round draws eight, including suspicious and ordinary messages. In the same session, ten rounds use all 80 without repeating. After that, the deck reshuffles. Reloading resets solo history.

How does scoring work?

A correct answer earns 100 points. Timed mode adds up to 40 speed points: one point per half-second left. Wrong answers and timeouts earn zero. Practice has no time limit or speed bonus. In real life, take your time.

How do live rooms work?

Create a room, share the code, let players join, and start as host. Everyone gets the same eight cases and a shared 20-second clock per case. Scores are calculated on the server. New players must join before the round starts. Rooms support up to 24 players and expire after two hours.

Can I cheat by inspecting the source?

This is an open-source casual learning game. It is not suitable for prize awards, exams, or adversarial competition. The server enforces deadlines and one answer per case, but the public case bank can be studied.

What happens if I lose connection?

Your player session can reconnect in the same tab. A late answer cannot score after a case closes. If the room service is unavailable, practice and timed solo still work.

Can Eian build something for me?

Yes, get in touch to discuss your idea. Visit Eian’s portfolio or email limsieian@gmail.com. Enquiries are not automatically answered by this game.
